❓ Frequently asked questions

What's the difference between screen resolution and viewport size?

Screen resolution is your display's full pixel size; viewport is the visible area of the browser window, which shrinks when the window isn't maximized.

What does device pixel ratio mean?

It's the ratio of physical pixels to CSS pixels. A value of 2 (Retina/HiDPI) means text and images render extra sharp.

Is any of this data sent anywhere?

No. All values are read from your browser locally and never leave your device.
